security.title: Secure Enrollment
security.description: Your information is protected with SSL encryption

intro.text: Thank you for selecting Quick Pass Traffic School. Please fill in all required information below to complete your enrollment.
intro.important: Important: Provide accurate and complete information to ensure your certificate is processed without delay.

arizona.important: Important: Court fees vary by your specific court. They are paid directly to your court — separate from the Quick Pass school fee. The fee breakdown will update in the banner above once you select your court.
arizona.courtDateNote: ⚠️ If your original court date has already passed, enter the extension date granted by your court. You must complete the course at least 7 days before your court date.

eligibility.title: ✅ Affirmation of Eligibility — Please confirm all of the following:
eligibility.elig1: I have NOT attended an Arizona Defensive Driving course within the past 12 months. (12 months must pass between the citation dates of dismissed violations.)
eligibility.elig2: My violation is eligible for diversion — it appears on the Arizona Supreme Court's list of eligible violations and is not a DUI, criminal speeding, or criminal traffic offense.
eligibility.elig3: I am enrolling to dismiss only one (1) traffic violation with this course.
eligibility.elig4: If I hold a Commercial Driver's License (CDL), the vehicle I was driving at the time of the violation was NOT a commercial vehicle.
eligibility.elig5: I will complete this course at least 7 days before my court date (or court-approved extension date).
eligibility.elig6: I have NOT already paid the citation fine to the court for the violation I wish to dismiss.
